content.scenario: A company, 'GreenCycle', designs and assembles bicycles using parts sourced from various suppliers. GreenCycle sells these bicycles under its own brand name through its website and retail stores. A consumer purchases a bicycle that has a defective brake system, causing an accident.
content.outcome: GreenCycle is considered the product manufacturer, as it designed and assembled the bicycles, and is therefore responsible for the defective product, liable to compensate the consumer for any harm caused.
